product.title: Small Markets, Big Money
product.summary: How market size shapes what a team can spend and earn.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students run a small-market front office and make spending and revenue decisions that a big-market team would make differently, seeing where market size helps and where it constrains.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Runs end-to-end and is publicly reachable. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16. Genuine branching with transparent tradeoffs — every option shows its stat deltas before commitment, and two opposed paths ended far apart (competitive balance 50 versus 84).
knownBlockers: On a 390px screen the step tracker overflows the right edge with no scroll cue.

curation.tierBasis: The best writing in the account, over real branching. Every option shows its stakeholder deltas before commitment, and two opposed paths ended far apart on competitive balance. Nothing here can be bluffed.
